title: Tickets, Seats and Trouble
label: ch:ka-tickets-seats-and-trouble
canDo: I can buy a ticket and a seat, ask when the bus or train leaves, say I have missed the bus or lost my bag and report it, ask for medicine, and read the letter ಔ in auṣadha.

payoff.summary: Complete the last lesson of chapter 314: buy a ticket, ask the time, report a problem on a trip, and read and write ಔ.
